tasks.title: Conversation #121
tasks.transcript:
Man: I'm thinking about buying a new car, but I can't decide on the model.
Woman: What are you looking for in a car?
Man: Mainly good fuel and economy.
Woman: Have you thought about getting in Arnie's? They're known for that.
Man: No. I haven't. I'll check them out online tonight. Thanks for the suggestion.

questions.stem: What is the man looking for in a new car?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士想要一辆新车具备什么特点？ 定位原文：Man: Mainly good fuel economy. （原文中 “fuel and economy” 应为 “fuel economy”，即燃油经济性） 选项分析： A. A spacious interior 宽敞的内部空间。对话中未提及空间，所以A选项错误。 B. Better fuel efficiency 更好的燃油效率。男士明确说主要看燃油经济性，所以B选项正确。 C. Improved safety features 改进的安全特性。对话中未提及安全，所以C选项错误。 D. An affordable price 可承受的价格。对话中未提及价格，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士接下来最可能会做什么？ 定位原文：Man: I'll check them out online tonight. 选项分析： A. Call a repair shop 给修理厂打电话。对话中未提及修车，所以A选项错误。 B. Ask more friends for advice 向更多朋友征求意见。男士没有说要再问别人，而是直接说上网查，所以B选项错误。 C. Research the recommended cars 研究被推荐的车型。男士明确说今晚会在网上查看（check them out online），所以C选项正确。 D. Rent a car tonight 今晚租一辆车。对话中未提及租车，所以D选项错误。
